messages:
deploy-bot: roll complete: v0.9.3 -> prod-eu3. Auto-smoke kicked off: synth-embed, kv-prefill, latency-sanity. Results: 29/32 ok, 3 warn.

nina: saw synth-embed p95 jump in eu3 to ~2.0s, baseline ~0.55s. Errors small but p95 unacceptable for some customers.

omar: digging into node logs, seeing repeated Full GC cycles after quant2 model init. Could be memory footprint issue with new quant patch.

kevin: can we hot-route eu3 embed traffic to last-known-good variant until ML can patch? Prefer not to rollback whole service.

tara: +1. We have traffic routing control, can pin model-variant per-region. I can run the routing patch.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1281 (severity: low). Assigned: platform, ml-team.

tara: applying route pin: /v1/embed -> model=open-embed-stable (100%) in eu3. Change ID tr-2207.

deploy-bot: routing update tr-2207 applied in eu3.

omar: re-running synth after pin. snippet:
```json
{"probe":"synth-embed","region":"eu3","p50":98,"p95":580,"5xx":2}
```

nina: p95 improved to ~580ms. Still slightly above baseline but within SLO for now.

kevin: decision: regionally pin embed to stable variant in eu3, no rollback. ML to investigate quant2 memory/alloc and test smaller batch sizes. Platform to check container JVM flags and heap sizing.

tara: I'll add a short note to the 0.9.3 release page and schedule a follow-up with ML tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/0.9.3/notes#eu3-embed-pin

omar: created a short repro job to reproduce GC under quant2, sharing artifacts in infra-ticket.

nina: closing loop here. If we see regression elsewhere we escalate. For now marking this thread resolved once postmortem-lite is filed. :white_check_mark:
